finding: New break fault was observed about20s after successful CLEAR with PWM off. A stale vector without BIF/B2IF cannot produce driverProtectionFlag through the audited handlers. Physical signal source remains unresolved.
diagnostic_limitation: Capture freezes first event and CLEAR does not rearm the trace. Newest fault has no separate waveform.
next_required_evidence: Separate next-event waveform after authorized CLEAR, retaining first event; PA6 and physically verified TP23 needed to localize pad path versus module. No automatic CLEAR, filter change, or motor trial.
errata_scope_note: Documented short-pulse issue concerns bidirectional BKBID mode; this build configures input-only. This does not exclude every hardware fault.
